maria_cs: Heads up — Zenith onboarding flagged a potential renewal risk. Their post-go-live checks show intermittent latency spikes affecting embedding calls. They asked about credits and whether we can tighten SLO comms before the exec review next week.

aj_devops: Thanks — can you drop the exact SLOs they're expecting? I want to see how our measured metrics map.

maria_cs: From the contract: uptime 99.9% monthly, p95 latency <= 120ms for text-gen and p99 <= 250ms for embeddings. They specifically called out embedding p99.

aj_devops: Got it. Our telemetry shows embeddings p99 ~ 280ms at peak during their initial traffic profile. Root cause looks like small-batch bursts causing cold KV-cache misses.

pat_account: @maria_cs @aj_devops we need a short note for Renewal Friday — if we can't meet p99, customer expects a credit calc and remediation plan. Can we draft both?

aj_devops: Yes. Quick mitigation options: 1) increase burst capacity for their Dedicated pool (config change), 2) enable persistent KV-cache warmers for their workload, 3) suggest a prompt-level batching change. I can propose config + warmers this week.

maria_cs: Awesome. For the credit calc, they want an estimate of token impact and monthly dollars. Finance will need a table. I'll loop in @pat_account to finalize numbers.

aj_devops: Sample remediation note to include in customer comms:

```
What we observed: embedding p99 was 280ms vs contract 250ms at peak traffic windows.
Immediate remediation: enable persistent KV-cache warmers and increase Dedicated burst capacity for 72h. Expected impact: reduce p99 to ~200-230ms during peak while we tune batching.
Follow-up: engineering will run a 48h load validation and share telemetry; if we miss SLO next month, we will apply pro-rata credits per contract section 4.2.
```

pat_account: That reads well. For the credit calc I need two numbers: minutes of SLO breach window and average tokens/sec impacted. Maria can you pull from the reporting dashboard?

maria_cs: On it. Pulling last 14 days. Early numbers: breach windows total ~35 minutes across 3 days, avg tokens/sec ~12k during those windows. Will send a spreadsheet in DM.

pat_account: Cool. One ask from CS leadership: capture the enablement playbook for their ops team so they can self-serve next incidents. Aj, can you draft 3-step runbook we can share?

aj_devops: Yup — short runbook + commands. Example snippet to include:

```bash
# warm cache for model embeddings
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warm-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"embed-v1","prompts": ["warm1","warm2"]}'

# scale burst capacity
redwoodctl capacity set --customer zenith --burst 2
```

maria_cs: Perfect. Once aj posts the runbook and I attach telemetry + credit calc, I'll draft the comm to Zenith PM and schedule a 30m remediation call.

pat_account: Thanks all. Last thing — please add a line in the comm that outlines expected timeline for credit decision (finance needs 5 business days after telemetry validation).

maria_cs: Will do. Target: comm out by EOD tomorrow, remediation plan queued for ops, follow-up validation in 72h. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T12:04:17Z finished for infra/kv-warmers (canary)

aj_devops: Noted — canary deploy looks good. I'll start the warmers once you greenlight.

pat_account: Great thread — I'll prep the renewal slide with a summary and attach this thread as evidence.

maria_cs: Closing loop here, will DM spreadsheet. Thanks everyone. :pray:
